paragraphs: robotbehavior is a Rust interface library for writing robot applications against capabilities: move to a target, read a structured state, or calculate a command each control cycle. A hardware driver or simulator implements those capabilities; this crate supplies their shared types and contracts.

Use it when you want to reuse application or controller code across compatible backends, or implement a new driver in the same vocabulary. To connect to a robot, also choose its driver. To simulate physics, choose a physics backend such as RsBullet. This crate alone does neither.
features: Default features are empty. The Rust motion, control, state, and model interfaces work without Roplat.
